purpose: Question an uncertain outcome or mark its confirmation.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
express feelings speak politely show respect
果たして + question / outcome clause
Will this method really get us there in time?
Who, in the end, will stay to the finish?
Sure enough, as forecast, snow began falling in the evening.
formation: 果たして + question / outcome clause
restrictions: Questions often express genuine doubt; statements can confirm an expectation.
mistake: Do not translate it as a certainty in every context.
